title: Design System: LabSite Studio — template "導引" (basic)

on-zone.note: Fixed white by the Dark Zone Rule; themes.js always emits #ffffff.

on-join.note: Fixed white by the Dark Zone Rule.

mark.note: Generated themes keep amber hue 75 (oklch(0.8 0.16 75)); location and focus only.

display.purpose: The lab name on the directory's ink sign plate; once per site.

title.purpose: Zone band labels and research area titles.

other-language.purpose: The translation beneath every sign heading, soft ink, with its lang attribute.

label.purpose: Table heads, link plates, the language switch.

themeSurface.generator: src/site/themes.js makeTheme/generateThemes: zone hues via OKLCH schemes (wayfinding, analogous, mono, duo), each darkened until 4.6:1 against white and wall; join hue moved 90deg if within 40deg of amber (hue 75); radius 0, 4 or 10px; Latin-first font pairs from FONT_PAIRS.
themeSurface.contrastGate: contrastIssues(vars) over CONTRAST_PAIRS must return no issues (4.5:1).
fixedStructure: markup contract (docs/markup-convention.md) and templates/basic class names
data-zone values: research, team, publications, join
layout grid, breakpoints and spacing in site.css

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px var(--mark)
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus only. Not elevation; the system has no elevation shadows.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Arrow advance (0.35-0.45s) and directory power-up (0.5-0.6s, 90ms stagger).

motion.name: ease-out-cubic
motion.purpose: Zone band colour sweep, 0.5s, left to right.

motion.name: colour-swap
motion.purpose: Button, header plate and link plate hover fills.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and transforms off; everything static.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink sign button with a trailing arrow; inverts on hover.

narrative.overview:
A lab website read the way a visitor reads a Taiwanese hospital or campus sign program: find the building directory, pick a zone, follow its colour. Every page answers "where do I go next." Four zone colours (research, team, publications, join) each own whole full-width bands and colour their own page; signage-white plates sit on a cool wall grey; near-black ink carries the type. One amber mark means "you are here," and nothing else on the site is amber.

The type is sign type: a heavy Chinese label with the other language set smaller and lighter beneath it, in one sans family. Depth is flat: plates meet and overlap, nothing casts a shadow. The only icon family is the arrow. Where a photo is missing, a flat wayfinding pictogram plate stands in and says it must be replaced.

This is a template platform, so the system has two layers. **Structure** (the markup contract in `docs/markup-convention.md` and the class names of `templates/basic`, the four-zone model, the layout, the motion, the focus construction) is shared by every template. **Theme** (the custom properties in `css/theme.css` plus its web-font `@import`) is the swappable surface; `src/site/themes.js` generates new contrast-safe token sets against it. A skin may restyle `site.css`, but it keeps the class names and the rules below.
keyCharacteristics: Four zones, each a dark colour carrying white text; the zone colour is the page's identity.
One amber "you are here" mark, shared with keyboard focus.
Bilingual sign headings: heavy primary-language label, smaller other-language line beneath.
Flat planes; depth from plates overlapping bands.
Rule-ruled lists (3px ink top rule, 1px rule dividers) instead of cards.

rules.name: The You-Are-Here Rule
rules.body: Amber marks only location and focus: the current page, the focused element, selection, the skip link. A generated theme moves any zone hue within 40 degrees of amber away from it.

rules.name: The Dark Zone Rule
rules.body: All four zones are dark enough to carry white text at 4.5:1, and dark enough to read as text on plate and wall at 4.5:1. `--on-zone` and `--on-join` stay white; a theme that needs dark text on a zone is outside the system.

rules.name: The Theme Surface Rule
rules.body: Only the `:root` custom properties in `css/theme.css` (zone-research, zone-team, zone-publications, zone-join, on-zone, on-join, mark, ink, ink-soft, wall, plate, rule, font, radius, max) and the font `@import` are swappable. Every pair in `CONTRAST_PAIRS` (`src/site/themes.js`) must pass 4.5:1 before a theme ships. Nothing in `site.css` may introduce a new colour that a theme cannot reach.

rules.name: The Bilingual Sign Rule
rules.body: Every section heading is a pair: the page language as a heavy label, the other language smaller, 600 weight, soft ink, directly beneath, marked with its `lang`. The second line is a translation, never a category tag or a teaser.

rules.name: The Keep-All Rule
rules.body: Short sign labels (band descriptors, PI list items, tags, member roles, alumni destinations) use `word-break: keep-all` with `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, so Chinese breaks only at spaces and 、，, never inside a word. Headings balance; paragraphs and list items wrap pretty.

rules.name: The Overlapping Plate Rule
rules.body: If something needs to read as in front, it overlaps the plane behind it; it never floats on a shadow.

dos: Do give every new page or section a zone through `data-zone` (research, team, publications, join) and let `--zone` / `--on` colour it.
Do set every section heading as a bilingual sign: heavy label, other-language line beneath with `lang`.
Do make depth by overlapping plates over bands.
Do use the arrow (24-unit viewBox, 2.6 stroke, square caps) as the only icon.
Do keep amber for the current page, focus, selection and the skip link only.
Do run every generated theme through `contrastIssues()`; all four zones dark, white text on all of them.
Do change a template's look through `css/theme.css` tokens and the font `@import`; change `site.css` only as a skin that keeps the class names.
Do keep motion to the directory power-up and the band sweep, with exponential ease-outs, and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't use shadows for elevation; the focus ring is the only `box-shadow`.
Don't add icon families, glyph icons or decorative illustrations; arrows and replaceable pictograms only.
Don't add a big photo hero or a grid of identical icon cards; the directory board is the home page.
Don't use amber, or any hue within 40 degrees of it, as a zone colour.
Don't put dark text on a zone fill or light a zone too pale to carry white text.
Don't add a small label above a heading; the second sign line goes beneath, and it is a translation.
Don't introduce colours in `site.css` that a theme cannot reach, or bake any school or department identity into a template.
